plan.title: Paired DESeq2 DE: treated vs control per subject
plan.analytical_narrative: Five subjects each contribute a control and a treated blood sample (paired design, 12000 genes x 10 samples, raw STAR/featureCounts integer counts). The research question — which genes respond to treatment within each subject — requires a within-subject paired comparison, so the model blocks on subject and tests the condition effect controlling for between-subject variation (design ~ subject + condition). QC first checks that samples cluster as expected before committing to the model; strandedness is unknown in the profile so it is inferred/flagged as a caveat rather than assumed. After DESeq2 Wald testing with apeglm shrinkage and BH-adjusted independent filtering, the ranked gene list (Wald statistic) feeds fgsea preranked enrichment against MSigDB Hallmark (available locally), followed by Reactome and WikiPathways (both available locally) as secondary collections. A final report step consolidates DE results, diagnostics, enrichment, and a reproducibility record. No translational/clinical outcome data are present in this profile, so no biomarker/safety/PK steps are added.
